notes.title: Roadmap for Future Improvements
notes.content:
I really appreciate everyone who played the demo and left feedback. The most common positive is it's very funny. The most common negatives are:

1. Needs the plot more explained
2. Needs more graphical interaction

These are both now high on the priority list. The plot issue is easy to fix. Orochi Park does have a plot, but I did not want to over-expose it. However, I will soon release a new demo version where your plot choices are more clearly explained.

In terms of graphical interaction, I am looking at making some UI improvements to give more than just textual interaction.
